```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load the packages and shared helpers used to subset, cluster, and plot GBCs.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  cache.path = file.path(
    here::here("results", "cache", "publication_pipeline"),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "/")
  )
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratExtend)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

})

# Load the analysis functions.
publication_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(publication_dir, "publication_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
```


```{r get_data}
# Load the olfactory-lineage object if it is not already in memory.
if (!exists("filtered_seurat_lineageb")) {
  filtered_seurat_lineageb <- readRDS(file.path(params$download_dir, "olfactory_lineage.rds"))
}
```



Get Ascl1+ cells 
```{r select-gbcs}
# Select the GBC clusters from the olfactory-lineage object.
DefaultAssay(filtered_seurat_lineageb) <- "RNA"

gbc_subset <- subset(
  filtered_seurat_lineageb,
  subset = Ascl1 > 0 
)
```

Recalculate dimensional reductions and clusters after subsetting.
```{r reprocess}
# Reprocess the GBC subset across the specified clustering resolutions.
res_cols <- grep("_snn_res\\.", colnames(gbc_subset@meta.data), value = TRUE)
gbc_subset@meta.data[res_cols] <- NULL
gbc_subsetb <- process_seurat_object(gbc_subset, resolution.range = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7))
```


Make and plot module scores
```{r plot-gbc-markers}
# Plot established marker panels to interpret the GBC-specific clusters.
marker_list <- list(
  Basal_RE                = c("Krt17", "Reg3g"),
  Bowmans                 = c("Sox9", "Wfdc18"),
  Goblet_cells            = c("Tff2", "Muc5b"),
  OB                      = c("Dcc", "Pou3f2", "Igfbpl1", "Dlx2"),
  Olf_Ensheathing         = c("Npy", "S100b"),
  Odontogenic_Epithelium  = c("Amelx", "Enam"),
  Fibroblasts             = c("Col1a1", "Col1a2"),
  Macrophages             = c("C1qb", "Cd68"),
  Monocytes               = c("S100a8", "S100a9", "Il1b"),
  Basal_OE                = c("Trp63", "Krt5"),
  GBC                     = c("Ascl1", "Kit"),
  INP                     = c("Neurod1", "Neurog1"),
  iOSN                    = c("Ebf2", "Gap43"),
  mOSN                    = c("Omp","Adcy3"),
  Sus                     = c("Cyp2a5", "Il33"),
  Tuft_Cells              = c("Ascl3", "Foxi1"))

add_module_scores_and_plot(
  seurat_obj = gbc_subsetb,
  marker_list = marker_list,
  cluster_resolution = "RNA_snn_res.0.7",
  min_genes_required = 2, 
  ctrl = 5,
  feature_plot_color_low = "white",
  feature_plot_color_high = "blue",
  reduction.name = "umap")

```


Cell Cycle Analysis
```{r cell_cycle_scores}
# Score cell-cycle phase so proliferating GBC states can be compared.
phase_analysis <- score_and_plot_cell_cycle(gbc_subsetb, cc_genes = cc.genes, reduction = "umap")

phase_plot <- phase_analysis[["phase_plot"]] + 
  theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2")
phase_plot


d <- DimPlot(gbc_subsetb, reduction = 'umap', group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.7", label = T)+ 
  theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2")

plotz <- d | phase_plot 
plotz
```



```{r summarize-cell-cycle}
# Calculate cell-cycle percentages per cluster for the phase-composition plot.
cc_phase_perc <- phase_analysis[["scored_seurat"]]@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cluster = phase_analysis[["scored_seurat"]]@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.0.7, Phase) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(cluster, Phase)

ggplot(cc_phase_perc, aes(x = factor(cluster), y = percent, fill = Phase)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Percentage", title = "Cell Cycle Phase Composition per Cluster") +
  theme_minimal()
```


Plot by sample to see if well distributed
```{r plot-gbcs-by-age}
# Order ages explicitly and plot the GBC subset across developmental time.
# Ensure the 'sample' factor is ordered correctly
gbc_subsetb$sample <- factor(gbc_subsetb$sample, levels = c("p1", "p3", "p5", "p8", "p15", "p22"))

seq_folder_colors <- c(
  "p5_R1_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p5_R2_counts" = "#23ffff",  

  "p8_R1_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p8_M_counts" = "#23ffff",  

  "p1_F_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p1_M_counts" = "#23ffff",  
  "p1_F_2_counts" = "#f6c141",  
  "p1_M_2_counts" = "#4169e1",  

  "p3_F_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p3_M_counts" = "#23ffff", 
  "p3_F_2_counts" = "#f6c141",  
  "p3_M_2_counts" = "#4169e1",  


  "p15_R1_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p15_F_counts" = "#23ffff", 

  "p22_F_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p22_M_counts" = "#23ffff",  
  "p22_F_2_counts" = "#f6c141",  
  "p22_M_2_counts" = "#4169e1"#,   

)

samples <- levels(gbc_subsetb$sample)

plots <- lapply(samples, function(s) {
  p <- DimPlot(gbc_subsetb[, gbc_subsetb$sample == s],
               reduction = "umap",
               group.by = "seq_folder",
               shuffle = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = seq_folder_colors) +
    ggtitle(s) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )
  return(p)
})

# Add axis labels only to first plot
plots[[1]] <- plots[[1]] + 
  theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2") 
# Combine with patchwork
p <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
p <- p + 
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )
p
```

Remove neuronal lineage cells for downstream analysis
```{r remove-neuronal-gbcs}
# Remove neuronal-like clusters to create the non-neuronal GBC object.
gbc_subset_noNeur <- subset(
  gbc_subsetb ,
  subset = (RNA_snn_res.0.6 %in%  c("0","1","2","5","9","10","11"))  
)
DimPlot(gbc_subset_noNeur, reduction = 'umap')
```
Identify positive markers at resolution 0.7 and export the full and filtered marker tables.
```{r find-gbc-markers}
# Find markers at the selected GBC resolution and optionally write their tables.
cluster_resolution = 0.7
Idents(object = gbc_subset_noNeur) <- paste0("RNA_snn_res.", cluster_resolution)

marker_results <- find_markers(gbc_subset_noNeur, paste0("RNA_snn_res.", cluster_resolution))
# Access the first data frame in the list
df1 <- marker_results[[1]]
# Save the first data frame to a CSV file
write.csv(
  df1,
  file = file.path(params$output_dir, "markers", "allMarkers_Ascl1_pos.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
# Access the second data frame in the list
df2 <- marker_results[[2]]
# Save the second data frame to a CSV file
write.csv(
  df2,
  file = file.path(params$output_dir, "markers", "topMarkers_Ascl1_pos.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

Where are marker genes expressed?
```{r label-gbc-clusters}
# Assign the established biological labels and colors to the final GBC clusters.

# Define marker-gene pairs.
plotgenessss <- list(
    CYP = c("Cyp2a5", "Sec14l3"),
    HBC = c("Krt5", "Trp63"),
    MV  = c("Pou2f3", "Ascl3"),
    BG  = c("Sox9", "Wfdc18")
)

# Calculate shared UMAP crop limits while trimming only extreme outliers.
umap_limits <- as.data.frame(
    gbc_subset_noNeur@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
) %>%
    summarise(
        xmin = quantile(umap_1, 0.01),
        xmax = quantile(umap_1, 0.99),
        ymin = quantile(umap_2, 0.01),
        ymax = quantile(umap_2, 0.99)
    )

# Plot each marker pair with the same crop, theme, and layout.

# Create one two-gene panel for each marker group.
all_plots <- lapply(plotgenessss, function(genes) {
    create_gene_pair_plot(gbc_subset_noNeur, genes)
})

# Stack the marker-group panels vertically.
final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = all_plots,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "v"
)

final_plot
```

```{r prepare-gbc-umap-data}
# Combine UMAP coordinates with metadata for the custom final GBC figure.
umap_embed <- Embeddings(gbc_subset_noNeur, "umap")

module_colors <- c(
  "Sus_Features1" = "#ffff33",
  "Bowmans_Features1" = "#f781bf",
  "Basal_OE_Features1" = "#a65628",
  "Tuft_Cells_Features1" = "#ff7f00",
  "GBC_Features1" = "#984ea3"
)
module_labels <- c(
  "Sus_Features1" = "Sustentacular",
  "Bowmans_Features1" = "Bowmans",
  "Basal_OE_Features1" = "HBC",
  "Tuft_Cells_Features1" = "Microvillus",
  "GBC_Features1" = "GBC"
)
modules <- names(module_colors)

plot_long <- FetchData(gbc_subset_noNeur, vars = c("umap_1", "umap_2", modules)) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(modules), names_to = "module", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(module = factor(module, levels = modules))

lins <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_long, score == 0),
             color = "grey90", size = 0.8, shape = 16, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_long, score > 0) |> arrange(score),
             aes(color = module, alpha = score), size = 1.8, shape = 16, stroke = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = module_colors, labels = module_labels) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.3, 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "UMAP Expression of Key Modules", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  guides(alpha = "none", color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)))

cluster_plot <- DimPlot(gbc_subset_noNeur, reduction = "umap", group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.7") +
  labs(title = "UMAP Clustering", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")

print(lins)
print(lins | cluster_plot)
```
```{r plot-gbc-cluster-membership}
# Summarize sample contributions and assemble the final GBC membership plots.
# Keep samples in figure order
sample_order <- c("p1", "p3", "p5", "p8", "p15", "p22")
sample_order <- sample_order[sample_order %in% unique(gbc_subset_noNeur$sample)]

# Use the same UMAP limits for every age panel
umap_coords <- Embeddings(gbc_subset_noNeur, "umap")
umap_limits <- list(
  xmin = min(umap_coords[, 1]),
  xmax = max(umap_coords[, 1]),
  ymin = min(umap_coords[, 2]),
  ymax = max(umap_coords[, 2])
)

# Colors for the retained noNeur clusters
cluster_colors <- c(
  "0" = "#F8766D",
  "1" = "#C49A00",
  "2" = "#53B400",
  "4" = "#00C094",
  "9" = "#00B6EB",
  "10" = "#A58AFF",
  "11" = "#FB61D7"
)

sample_umaps <- lapply(sample_order, function(sample_id) {
  DimPlot(
    gbc_subset_noNeur[, gbc_subset_noNeur$sample == sample_id],
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.7",
    cols = cluster_colors,
    pt.size = 0.5
  ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(umap_limits$xmin, umap_limits$xmax),
      ylim = c(umap_limits$ymin, umap_limits$ymax)
    ) +
    ggtitle(sample_id) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.1)
    )
})

# Put the panels in one row
age_umap_plot <- wrap_plots(sample_umaps, nrow = 1)

age_umap_plot
```

```{r save-gbc-object, cache=FALSE}
# Return the sample column to character type after plotting.
gbc_subset_noNeur$sample <- as.character(gbc_subset_noNeur$sample)

# Save the final non-neuronal GBC object.
if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  saveRDS(gbc_subset_noNeur, file.path(params$output_dir, "gbc_subset.rds"))
}
```
